sources.title: Museums Victoria ST34691: Chebec class sailing model
sources.read: Full collection text read on 2026-11-14; stated image/plan also inspected where recorded.
confirmed: Museum identifies three-masted French armed chebec, raised poop and lateen sail.
application: Retain three lateen masts, narrow open battery and low raised poop.

plan: Shallow framed hold -0.30L to +0.38L, sole -0.85 m; an actual fitted water cask and planked provisions box occupy supported side footprints. The narrow forward area stays clear; no invisible cable locker is claimed.
Low after cabin -0.47L to -0.35L, floor -0.25 m and modest hinged seat locker combining seating and storage, with no unsupported freestanding adult berth; no stacked gun decks.
2.0 × 1.4 m centerline hatch at +0.13L, offset poop companion, visible pump and belaying fittings.
Twenty open-deck guns retain clear working lanes; three lateen yards, detailed lead blocks and restrained stern rail/trim distinguish the fitting-out.
One high forward-cuddy casement uses a 0.55 × 0.195 m cut opening above the outside weather deck and below the quarterdeck beam; its two retained panes preserve the pointed stern terminal.
limitations: Le Requin is a family analogue, not a reproduction or a stock game interior plan.
Oars are a historical xebec trait but the reconstruction does not invent a full rowing battery or change the POTC armament.
The raised poop is source-confirmed; a grand after cabin or freestanding adult bed is not. The narrow authored cuddy is fitted with a combined seat locker while retaining its clear aisle.

The exact forward-casement arrangement is authored, not shown by an inspected historical or stock-game interior plan. The references establish the xebec family, lateen rig, timber vocabulary and low raised poop; the final glazing location follows actual clearance tests.

Actual full raw-GLB furniture decoding places one fitted water cask and one planked storage box near -0.0076L; the shallow narrow forward end cannot support the previously proposed cable-locker footprint. The hold remains one open framed provisions space, without a fictitious partition or unseen coil.

cabin.berth_omission_reason: The narrow pointed after cuddy cannot support a freestanding adult berth and a clear aisle on the authored sole. A modest hinged seat locker combining seating and storage are inferred; no grand cabin or recovered historical bed arrangement is claimed.
